purpose: Provenance for the one-time INT migration. Runtime truth remains database/base-digimon-list.json.

estimation.method: 5-nearest neighbours within the same DigiGame rank, using z-score-normalized hp/mp/atk/def/speed and inverse-distance weighting
estimation.note: Estimated values are starting balance values for species not represented by the pinned Dawn/Dusk dataset and can be tuned later.
